Meta.title: REAGE — Azeḍḍa n yiqeṛṛuyen d yimsentayen izzayriyen n Tuṛuft
Meta.description: REAGE tessemlili imezdaɣ izzayriyen n Tuṛuft ɣer Lezzayer: azeḍḍa n yiqeṛṛuyen d yimsentayen i tdamsa, tasentayt d usileɣ.

hero.kicker: Azeḍḍa n yimezdaɣ izzayriyen n Tuṛuft
hero.title: Nesmuttul izerfan izzayriyen, da akked dihin.
hero.subtitle: REAGE tessemlili iqeṛṛuyen d yimsentayen izzayriyen n Tuṛuft akken ad bnun assaɣen iǧehden d Lezzayer, ad bḍun tamusni, ad sgemmun azeḍḍa n laman.

free.title: Amaslaḍ ilelli
free.body: Rnu-d ɣer temɣiwent baṭel, teqqimeḍ teẓriḍ tidyanin d yisallen n uzeḍḍa.

paid.title: Amaslaḍ yettxellisen
paid.body: Sefrek tiddukla s lexlaṣ aseggasan, tkecmeḍ ɣer tedyanin tusligin d yimyagaren uslig.

about.title: Taqenṭert gar yimezdaɣ d Lezzayer
about.body: Tiddukla n usaḍuf 1901 i d-yennulfan deg 2006, REAGE tessemlili tilawin d yirgazen i icudden ɣer tneflit tadamsant n Lezzayer. Nessishil timliliyin, abeddel n tmusni d ulellet, war takebbanit, kan i lmend n tzemmar d yisenfaren.

what.title: Ayen i nxeddem
what.subtitle: Krad iferdisen deg wul n umahil-nneɣ.

network.title: Azeḍḍa
network.body: Asemlili n yimahalen n yimezdaɣ gar-asen akked yimeskaren idamsanen di Lezzayer.

entrepreneurship.title: Tasentayt
entrepreneurship.body: Asefrek n tnekfa, asnulfu d yisenfaren i d-yessuffuɣen azal ɣef sin idisan n Wagrakal.

training.title: Asileɣ
training.body: Abeṭṭu n tmusni s yisileɣen d ulellet i iwatan i wid n wannar.

events.empty: Ulac tadyant yettwaheggan tura. Uɣal-d ar zdat.

news.title: Isallen-nneɣ
news.subtitle: Isallen ineggura n tiddukla d yimaslaḍen-is.
news.empty: Isallen imezwura ad d-asen ar zdat.

support.title: Tallalt-ik tessenfaray azeḍḍa
support.body: Yal tikci tɛawen REAGE ad tesnulfu timliliyin, ad teɛiwen imawlan n yisenfaren, ad tesǧehed assaɣen gar Tuṛuft d Lezzayer. Lexlaṣ yettwasefrak s laman s HelloAsso — ulac idrimen i iɛeddan deg usmel-a.
support.note: Anekcum d usefrek ttwasefraken s laman s HelloAsso.

Presentation.title: Anwa-aɣ
Presentation.intro: REAGE — Azeḍḍa n yiqeṛṛuyen d yimsentayen izzayriyen n Tuṛuft — d tiddukla n usaḍuf 1901 i icudden imezdaɣ izzayriyen n Tuṛuft ɣer Lezzayer, ɣef tdamsa, tasentayt d usileɣ.
Presentation.mission1: Tallalt i tneflit tinmettant-tadamsant n Lezzayer.
Presentation.mission2: Asbeggen n temɣiwent n yiqeṛṛuyen d yimsentayen di temɣiwent tagraɣlant.
Presentation.mission3: Asneddu n yimeskaren idamsanen i nnfeɛ n Lezzayer.
Presentation.visionBody: Asǧehed n wassaɣen idamsanen gar Lezzayer d Tuṛuft s tdukliwin timaynutin i yedderen: abeṭṭu n tmusni, asexdem amyenṭaḍ d uselken n tezmert, ɣef sin idisan n Wagrakal — war takebbanit.
Presentation.historyBody: Tlul-d seg tnekfa i d-yebdan di tlemmast n yiseggasen 1990 sɣur imahalen izzayriyen d yifransis-izzayriyen, tiddukla tettwarna s wudem unṣib ass n 1 Fuṛaṛ 2006, deffir uɣtas i ittwaṭṭfen deg unejmuɛ adamsan ass n 14 Yunyu 2005 di ESCP.
Presentation.governanceBody: REAGE d tiddukla i yseddu usaḍuf aftransis n 1901. Aselway: Fetah Ouazzani.

Formation.title: Asileɣ
Formation.intro: Isileɣen ileqqaqen s usenfer i usǧehed n tzemmar d usemɣer n tsentayt, ɣef krad iferdisen: asnerni n tzemmar, tallalt i tsentayt d ulellet udmawan.
Formation.p1Body: Erbeḥ tasusmi d tmara deg umeslay, sken tazmert-ik deg uskan.
Formation.p2Body: Seg tneɣrit ɣer uskan: gzu imahilen n uwellih, kcem ɣer-sen.
Formation.p3Body: Tiririt tilaqt i twennaḍt tamaynut n tkebbaniyin.

AboutPage.title: Issin-aɣ
AboutPage.intro: REAGE tessemlili imezdaɣ izzayriyen n Tuṛuft ɣer Lezzayer, ɣef tdamsa, tasentayt d usileɣ — war takebbanit.
AboutPage.howBody: Azeḍḍa yettwasuddes s yigrawen isentanen (tasentayt, asexdem, tadrimt, tafellaḥt, asileɣ) d yigrawen n yimezwura s tesdawit. Yal agraw yettusefrak s yiɛeggalen i yebɣan, yeldi i yimaslaḍen.
AboutPage.boardBody: Aseqqamu amsefrak yessemlili udmawen seg umaḍal adamsan d unelmad i uwellih n tigawin n tiddukla. Talɣa tufrint ad d-tas ar zdat.
AboutPage.orgBody: Asuddes agensan (asqamu, tismilin, igrawen) ad yettwafru ar zdat.
AboutPage.historyBody: Yelul-d seg tnekfa i d-yebdan di tlemmast n yiseggasen 1990 sɣur imahalen izzayriyen d yifransis-izzayriyen, tiddukla tettwarna s wudem unṣib ass n 1 Fuṛaṛ 2006, deffir unejmuɛ adamsan ass n 14 Yunyu 2005 di ESCP. Aselway: Fetah Ouazzani.
AboutPage.impactBody: Inarpayen idamsanen, tinaḍin d temliliyin smelqayen meyyat n yimahalen, ssishlen tideukliwin gar Tuṛuft d Lezzayer. Asɣan ufrin ad d-yas ar zdat.

EventsPage.title: Tidyanin-nneɣ
EventsPage.intro: Af-d izenziyen i d-iteddun n uzeḍḍa d tsuffaɣ tizeryanin.
EventsPage.afterworkBody: Tamlilit tarurmidt gar yimaslaḍen seg yal annar. Tiɣimit taneggarut tesmelqa azal n meyyat n yemdanen seg yal taɣult.
EventsPage.picnicBody: Imaslaḍen d twaculin myagaren di Paris deg tegnit yelhan.
EventsPage.ramadanBody: Imensi aseggasan n Ṛemḍan yesmelqay azeḍḍa ɣef yiwen n laftaṛ aṛfiq (azemz ɣur-s, yettwasentem yal aseggas).
EventsPage.dynamicNote: Ulac tadyant yettwasuffɣen tura. Uɣal-d ar zdat.

GroupsPage.title: Igrawen
GroupsPage.intro: REAGE yettwasuddes s yigrawen isentanen. Yal agraw yesmelqay imaslaḍen ɣef usentel, yettusefrak s yiɛeggalen i yebɣan. Igrawen nniḍen ad d-ldin ar zdat.
GroupsPage.entrepreneurshipBody: Allel n yimawlan n yisenfaren d usnulfu ɣef sin idisan n Wagrakal.
GroupsPage.investingBody: Abeṭṭu n yisalen d tegnatin i usexdem d tsentayt di Lezzayer.
GroupsPage.trainingBody: Ahilen d ulellet i usnerni n tzemmar. Wali asebter n yisileɣen.
GroupsPage.agricultureBody: Annaren ifellaḥen d tneẓẓut: agraw deg usbeddi.
GroupsPage.financeBody: Tabankit, isuqen d uɣawsa: agraw deg usbeddi.

UniversitiesPage.title: Azeḍḍa asdawan
UniversitiesPage.intro: Yal tasdawit tameqqrant ɣur-s agraw n yimezwura deg REAGE, di Fṛansa d beṛṛa. Nadi tin-ik.
UniversitiesPage.empty: Ulac tasdawit i yemṣadan d unadi-k.
